privileged_info_for_vlm: The Site Title must be exactly 'Kafka Docs'. The Site Subtitle must be 'Event Streaming Platform Reference'. The homepage tiddler title is 'Kafka Knowledge Base'. The Default Tiddlers setting in the Control Panel must be '[[Kafka Knowledge Base]]'.
